note: The suite disc psm-suite-s6b: demo/psm/suite/build.py --tag s6b --list demo/psm/suite/suite_s6b.json. s5b with ao4-d in place of ao4-c: scene C gains the mode 3+M (the lightmaps and a tile a hen: the movers' half of AO2_DESIGN.md) and the splits 3|3+M, 3+M|2, 3+M|3+M. hero1 is Junior's h1c (the living room). RUN ALL runs ao4 then hero1: a hud1c build may hang by design. Times are ESTIMATE, not measured. Nothing on this disc has run on a console.  s6b is s6 with the hens-eyes entry added (hen_spike.c: rays against a collision sweep for the same hens in the room; RUN ALL 3). It supersedes s5, s5b and s6 if none has run.

tests.name: ao4
tests.what: AO side by side: spheres, corner, room+hens. 90 s
tests.read: photo every page; START = live; L/R scene, X split

tests.name: hero1
tests.what: skinned hero, pass costs, room + hens. ~50 s
tests.read: photo every page; START = live (keys on the last page)

tests.name: hens-eyes
tests.what: hens: rays vs collision sweep, cycles. ~50 s
tests.read: photo every page + graph; START = live: X mode, Y hens

tests.name: ao1c
tests.what: town AO autorun as s3, then Y = CLAY view. ~1 min
tests.read: pages as on s3; then live: Y CLAY, X AO OFF/1/2

tests.name: ao1c-live
tests.what: town free walk: X AO OFF/1/2, Y CLAY/TEXTURED
tests.read: photo pairs at one spot: CLAY, AO OFF/1/2; then TEXTURED

tests.name: hud1c-1
tests.what: hud1b with the ASIC error events off
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves

tests.name: hud1c-2
tests.what: hud1b with no DIAG box in the opaque list
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves

tests.name: hud1c-3
tests.what: hud1b with no 64 KB DIAG texture
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves
